_about: Source benchmarks of the 80 tasks in github.com/harbor-index/harbor-index-1.0 (tasks/ directory, read 2026-11-12). Counts come from task directory name prefixes; the repository has no file that maps tasks to benchmarks. One task (build-word2vec-pipeline) has no prefix and is not counted here. Names are spelled as in the Adapter List so that they match the pool; the task prefixes are hle, spider2-dbt, swtbenchverified and tb (Terminal Bench 2 in the paper's Figure 5).
